create_ImageReader_cv2: create an ImageReader with cv2 backend to read images from a base path as numpy arrays
create_ImageReader_pil: create an ImageReader with pil backend to read images from a base path as PIL Image objects
read_image_cv2: read an image using Cv2Reader to load and convert it from BGR to RGB format
read_image_pil: read an image using PILReader to open and convert it to RGB mode
review_ImageReader_init: review the ImageReader class and its lazy initialization of the underlying reader backend
